# Interfacer API

> One API for every API your product needs to talk to.

Interfacer API is an integration platform for software teams. Instead of building and maintaining separate connections to hundreds of third-party services, developers call a single unified API. Interfacer handles OAuth and key management, automatic retries, rate-limit backoff, and webhook delivery, so product teams can ship integrations in days rather than quarters.

## Guides

- [Blog](https://interfacerapi.com/blog/index.html): Notes from the Interfacer API team.
- [Why token refresh is the silent killer of integrations](https://interfacerapi.com/blog/why-token-refresh-is-the-silent-killer-of-integrat.html): Most broken integrations are not caused by API changes. They are caused by expired credentials nobody noticed.
- [Retries done right: backoff, jitter, and knowing when to give up](https://interfacerapi.com/blog/retries-done-right-backoff-jitter-and-knowing-when.html): A practical guide to retrying third-party API calls without making an outage worse.
- [Build vs. buy: a checklist for your next integration](https://interfacerapi.com/blog/build-vs-buy-a-checklist-for-your-next-integration.html): Five questions to ask before your team commits a quarter to building a one-off connector.
